company.name: Techopolis LLC
company.mission: Creating privacy-focused, accessible experiences for iOS, macOS, visionOS, and beyond.
company.description: Techopolis is an app development company that specializes in building privacy-focused, accessible applications for Apple platforms. Founded by Michael Doise, the company creates apps with an emphasis on user privacy, on-device processing, and inclusive design.

team.name: Taylor Arndt
team.description: Taylor is a developer and accessibility specialist who is blind and neurodivergent. Taylor uses AI as a support system for coding, communication, and writing.

team.name: Michael Doise
team.description: Michael founded Techopolis and handles technical infrastructure.

values: Privacy-first: All data processed on-device whenever possible
Accessibility: Every app is designed to be fully accessible for everyone
Quality: Native apps built for each platform, not cross-platform compromises

apps.name: Perspective Intelligence
apps.description: Perspective Intelligence is a private on-device AI assistant for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. It offers chat functionality, audio transcription, and image text recognition — all processed locally on the user's device using Apple Foundation Models.
freeFeatures: Full chat experience with natural conversations
AI Vision for describing surroundings and identifying objects
Export conversations as plain text or markdown
Apple Watch support for basic chats
On-device processing using Apple Foundation Models
apps.privacy: All features rely on on-device processing. Your data never leaves your device. Web search and weather features can be disabled in Settings.

apps.name: Perspective Notify
apps.description: Push notification service powered by OneSignal. Send and manage push notifications for your apps and services.

apps.name: Perspective Meetings
apps.description: Organizes recurring meeting links (Zoom, Google Meet) in one centralized location. Keep all your meeting links organized and accessible.

apps.name: Beyond The Gallery
apps.description: A community platform for discovering and sharing Apple Shortcuts automations. Find, share, and explore creative shortcuts built by the community.

apps.name: Current City
apps.description: Displays the user's current location and city information. Built for travelers who want to quickly see where they are.

services.name: Native App Development
services.description: Custom native mobile app development for iOS and Android. Apps are completely native on each platform, built at a competitive price. Techopolis specializes in creating accessible, privacy-focused applications.

services.name: Accessibility Testing & Auditing
services.description: Comprehensive mobile app accessibility testing to enhance usability across iOS, Android, and visionOS platforms. Includes testing with assistive technologies like VoiceOver, WCAG compliance review, and optional remediation services to fix accessibility issues found.

services.name: User Experience Testing
services.description: User experience testing to evaluate whether products function effectively across all user types. Techopolis tests apps to ensure they work for diverse audiences.

courses.name: SwiftUI Basics

courses.name: Practical Python
courses.description: Learn Python with a focus on automation and task completion. Practical, hands-on approach to Python programming.

courses.name: Apple App Development
courses.description: Comprehensive course for developing applications across Apple platforms.

courses.name: Accessing the Mac Terminal Accessibly
courses.description: Learn to use the Mac Terminal with VoiceOver screen reader. Perfect for blind and low-vision developers getting started with the command line.
